name: Apply Wall Finish (Roll Method)
intent: Cut in to masked trim, then roll the wall field with an 18-inch roller. One coat per module invocation. Scenarios that need two coats list this module twice in the modules[] sequence. Coat 2 is slightly faster on smooth walls (less lap reworking) and same-rate on textured walls.
doctrine: Cut-in to taped trim is faster than freehand cut-in to ceiling because the tape line provides a stop. The 120 LF/hr rate is the same on both coats — re-cutting to tape is mechanical, not skill-bound. Roll rate is texture-driven: smooth walls accept paint cleanly, textured walls require slower laydown to fill profile. Texture modifier is OFF in modifier_eligibility because the rate variant already encodes texture; applying it twice would double-count.
